description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Zend_XmlRpc_Request_Http' which extends 'Zend_XmlRpc_Request'. It implements handling of XML-RPC requests received via HTTP, including reading raw request data, headers, and reconstructing the full HTTP request.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Request_Http
classes.description: Handles XML-RPC HTTP requests by reading raw POST data and HTTP headers, extending Zend_XmlRpc_Request.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Reads raw POST data from php://input; initializes XML request or sets fault if data is unavailable.

methods.name: getRawRequest
methods.description: Returns the raw XML data received via HTTP POST.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves all HTTP headers as key-value pairs.

methods.name: getFullRequest
methods.description: Returns the complete HTTP request including headers and XML content.
